description: Solar generation forecasting - LECO Nawala substation, Colombo, Sri Lanka
output_unit: kW per customer assuming fleet-average 5 kWp horizontal-reference system

user_scaling.fleet_avg_capacity_note: Estimated from peak observed per-customer export (4.47 kW) divided by assumed 0.82 peak efficiency. Replace with real fleet average if LECO meter registration data (kWp per installation) becomes available.
user_scaling.poa_model: isotropic sky model (Hay-Davies diffuse) with albedo=0.20
user_scaling.solar_azimuth_note: Solar azimuth must be computed alongside solar_elevation using the same Spencer equation. Convention: 0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W (meteorological). formula: atan2(sin(H), cos(H)*sin(lat) - tan(decl)*cos(lat)) + 180 deg, mod 360
user_scaling.panel_azimuth_note: Azimuth property from user profile: accepts compass string (N/NE/E/SE/S/SW/W/NW) or numeric degrees (0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W). For Sri Lanka (6.9 N), south-facing (180 deg) is optimal.

feature_notes.solar_elevation: Spencer-equation sun elevation in degrees; lat=6.8895, lon=79.8955
feature_notes.hour_angle: Hour angle in degrees from solar noon
feature_notes.lag features: Shift by 1/2/4 x 15-min intervals of GHI (shortwave_radiation) / DNI / cloud_cover
feature_notes.rolling means: ghi_roll4 = mean(GHI, 4 periods), ghi_roll8 = mean(GHI, 8 periods), cloud_roll4 = mean(cloud_cover, 4 periods)
feature_notes.is_day: 1 if sun is above horizon, else 0 (from Open-Meteo)

training_data_source: LECO smart meter load profile - Nawala substation (files: LP-AZ0247-2026-01.csv, LP-AZ0247-2026-02.csv)
solar_identification_method: night_ratio <= 0.08 AND max_kw >= 0.05 AND n_nonzero >= 100; then median reading interval <= 20 min; then >= 3 meters reporting per interval
data_quality_notes: Retrained on clean Jan + Feb 2026 LECO export (the prior dataset had corrupted records). Meters with constant non-zero export at all hours are excluded as cumulative-register artefacts. Daily-resolution meters are dropped by the 15-min median-interval filter. Per-customer target is invariant to meter communication gaps. Performance expected to improve further with 6+ months of consistent smart-meter data.

mlnet_integration.user_scaling: See SolarForecastScaler.ScaleToUserSystem() in the mobile-app backend.
mlnet_integration.note: Input must be float32[] of length 29, features ordered exactly as feature_cols list above.
